name: Teardrops on breakout-risk junctions
description: Advisory: a teardrop (fillet) where a thin trace meets a small-annular via/pad relieves drill-breakout and mechanical stress. Flags only the junctions where a teardrop would materially help (thin trace into a small-ring hole with no widening) -- not the absence of teardrops in general.
what_it_measures: Count of thin-trace-to-small-annular-hole junctions with no teardrop widening.
